surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
Open the archive at tar_path. Resolve dest_path to an absolute base directory. For each member, return False if it is a symbolic link or hard link. Normalize the extraction path by joining the member name to dest_path and resolving parent-directory references; return False if the normalized path is not under dest_path. Extract only regular files and directories to their validated paths, preventing existing destination symlinks from diverting writes outside dest_path. On any validation or extraction failure, return False. Return True after all members are successfully processed.
END_PLAN
